children.comment: Maximum distance for a valid selection.

children.text: Check for valid touch position before running selection procedures.

parameters.expression:
distance(
    3DCamera.CanvasToLayerX("Nodes", Touch.AbsoluteX, Touch.AbsoluteY, NodeBase.Z),
    3DCamera.CanvasToLayerY("Nodes", Touch.AbsoluteX, Touch.AbsoluteY, NodeBase.Z),
    NodeBase.X,
    NodeBase.Y
)

children.text: If there is a visible node close enough to the selection point, select it.

parameters.value:
distance(
    3DCamera.CanvasToLayerX("Nodes", Touch.AbsoluteX, Touch.AbsoluteY, NodeBase.Z),
    3DCamera.CanvasToLayerY("Nodes", Touch.AbsoluteX, Touch.AbsoluteY, NodeBase.Z),
    NodeBase.X,
    NodeBase.Y
) < MAX_SELECTION_DIST
